missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Костёр' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'горит'. 'Ярко' describes how brightly it burns.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Костёр' is the inanimate masculine accusative object of 'развели', identical to the nominative. 'Большой' is the agreeing adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive of location. 'Костра' is the genitive after 'возле', meaning near the fire. The fleeting vowel ё drops out, giving the stem 'костр-'.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Костру' is the dative after 'к', marking movement toward the fire. The fleeting ё drops, leaving the stem 'костр-'.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Костра' is the genitive after 'у', meaning by the fire. 'Вечером' adds the time, a classic camping scene.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'На костре' uses the prepositional form 'костре' after 'на' to show cooking over the fire.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of position. 'Костром' is the instrumental after 'над', meaning above the fire. The fleeting ё drops in the stem.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'О костре' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic of conversation. 'Долго' shows duration.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Костры' is the nominative plural subject of 'горели'. 'Яркие' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'в лесу' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Костры' is the inanimate accusative plural object of 'разжигали', matching the nominative plural. 'Быстро' adds the manner.
